slot_preflight.clip_side: tile.height x 1 (EFFECT_ANIMATION_HEX_RATIO 1) x animationScale 3: three tile heights square
slot_preflight.phone_px: about 65 CSS px (130 device px at 2x DPR) on a 400 px board
slot_preflight.desktop_px: about 162 CSS px on a 1000 px board
slot_preflight.draw_order: over the fighters; every slice of one cast starts together
slot_preflight.appear_stack: visual tags draw once per tile
slot_preflight.rows: 12 columns (longitude 0-11) x 10 rows (latitude 0-9); row 0 at the bottom; odd columns half a row higher
slot_preflight.carrier: zero-impact visual tags, target COORDINATES, power 2, rounds 1, one per slice with its tiles
slot_preflight.source: OpenDuelyst effect sheets, CC0 1.0, github.com/open-duelyst/duelyst @ df697549ca, recoloured and composited
